name: Chat
description: A whole conversation with an assistant: the messages, a box to write in, and the stop and jump-to-latest controls. It shows what you give it and reports what the person does; it never calls a model.

onSend.description: Called with the text when the person sends a message or picks a suggestion.

onStop.description: Called when the person presses Stop while a reply is on its way.

onApprove.description: Called with a tool's id when the person approves it.

onDeny.description: Called with a tool's id when the person declines it.

onRetry.description: Shows Try again on the last message when it failed.

status.description: Where the conversation is: ready for input, waiting for the first words, streaming, or failed.

suggestions.description: Prompts to offer when the chat is empty. Choosing one sends it.

headingLevel.description: Level of headings inside replies, 2 to 6.

keyboard: Tab: moves from the message list (focusable, so it can scroll with arrow keys) to the message box
Arrow keys / Page Up / Page Down: scroll the messages when the list has focus
requirements: The message list is a log that is NOT live: streamed text would be read token by token
One polite status line says "Assistant is responding" and "Response complete"; tools announce their own changes
The list follows new text only while the reader is at the bottom; scrolling up stops it and shows Jump to latest
Only the newest unanswered approval takes focus
The message list is keyboard-scrollable (focusable) and has a visible focus ring
Sending always returns the view to the latest message
screenReader: After sending: "Assistant is responding", later "Response complete"

use_when: An assistant, copilot or agent conversation
avoid_when: Chat between people with presence and typing: build on Message and PromptInput
anti_patterns: Auto-scrolling while someone is reading earlier messages
